Qingjing · Wuling E-Bike Ride.

The mountains will always be there. Wuling will always be there. Are you ready?

We are grateful to the Tamsui–Kavalan Trails Association for their trust, and to Hu Pang and A-Qing for their recommendation. They chose EasyTravelBike for 22 premium e-bike rentals for a two-day ride to Wuling. The dream was achieved successfully, and EasyTravelBike provided full support throughout the journey with a dedicated support vehicle.

Keep going! We look forward to exploring Taiwan’s hidden gems with you by e-bike. Come ride with us.

With the EasyTravelBike team, you are in good hands.

5-Day High-Intensity 1,200 km Around-Taiwan Ride (109 Hr)

Project 004 / Historical Project / Around Taiwan / Luggage Transfer
Photo Carousel
1 / 4
Content

We were pleased to support four international travelers with logistics at the invitation of Rushi Guan Travel Agency, helping them complete their five-day ride around Taiwan with peace of mind.

This was our first experience with a challenge of this intensity. Riders had to complete the route independently, without outside supplies or a support convoy. Our role was to drive 200–300 km each day and transfer their large luggage.

But can you imagine it? Driving is already exhausting, yet the clients were actually cycling through mountain roads. They started at 5 a.m. and arrived at the travel agency at 11 p.m. On the third day, they reached the Alishan section; the next day they did not arrive in Kenting until 6 a.m., slept for only four hours, and continued riding. It also rained all day for two days. When they set off with their bikes, we could clearly feel their struggle and helplessness, yet also their determination and perseverance to keep going. Time waits for no one—the clock was already running, leaving no room for hesitation.

It was truly a challenge to themselves, and we deeply admire the courage and perseverance of these riders.

Grand Taiwan Loop — Taitung, Hualien, Yilan, Keelung & Tamsui

Project 005 / Historical Project / Yilan–Hualien–Taitung / Northern Taiwan / Southern Taiwan / Around Taiwan / E-Bike Rental / Ride Leader
Photo Carousel
1 / 23
Content

Grand Taiwan Loop — Tainan, Kaohsiung, Pingtung, Chishang, Hualien, Keelung and Tamsui, collecting three major points in one journey. We thank A-Qing of Happy Ride and Brother Zhuang for their support and for giving EasyTravelBike the opportunity to join the group and learn along the way—enjoying the scenery while improving our ride-leading skills.

Along the way, we also met a Korean influencer, local cyclists, and fellow travelers walking around Taiwan, creating memorable encounters and cycling experiences.
